name: Austin Youth Development (AYD)
org: Austin Public Health, City of Austin
what_you_do: A City of Austin youth development program for ages 17 to 22. The page says the goal is for youth to earn a livable wage.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 22 who live in the Austin and Travis County area. You need a reliable ride. You must be able to get a driver's license within 90 days. You must have a high school diploma or GED, or be working toward one.
pay_detail: Pay, hours and length are not listed on the page.
how_to_apply: Complete the online interest form linked on the page. Call 512-972-4785 or email AYD@austintexas.gov.
notes: The page says youth work for the City while building skills toward education and career goals. It does not say what the work is, or give pay, hours, length or application dates. Call before applying. Office: 1416 Montopolis Drive, Austin.
